preconditions.description: The length of the strings s and t must be between 1 and 1,000,000.
Both strings s and t must have the same length n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in s) and all(c in '01' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both strings s and t must consist only of the characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if s != t else True
postconditions.description: If s cannot be converted to t, output -1.
The output must be a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of operations.

postconditions.expression: any(s[i] != t[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: If there is at least one differing character between s and t, output the minimum number of operations required.
